claims.text: The surge-tank cap valve on the HMMWV (M998-series) typically opens at a cooling-system pressure of approximately 15 psi (pounds per square inch).
TM 9-2320-280-20-1, Volume 1 (1996, including Change 2 dated 2004), specifies the pressure at which the HMMWV surge-tank cap vent opens.
The HMMWV surge-tank cap vent opens to release excess pressure and prevent over-pressurization of the cooling system.
